Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: tiny one-tile OpenTTD exchange depot source sprites.
Image1 GEOMETRY GUIDE is highest priority: each depot is a short square shed on ONE2:1 diamond tile, projected building fitting64x64. Copy EXACT geometry/view order of guide: NE closed visible walls, SE open right-facing mouth, SW open left-facing mouth, NW closed visible walls. Image2 previous art is ONLY reference for colors/materials: blue steel gantry integrated INSIDE a compact squat gray shed, yellow safety details. Replace the long open plaza shape entirely with the guide's square closed depot housing. No gantry stretching outward, no two tracks, no building spanning adjacent tiles, no long rail approach.
Transparent PNG regular4 columns x4 rows16poses, generous gutters, no labels or guidegraphics in artwork. All poses same2:1 diamond footing width and south tip. Fixed top-left lit TTD crisp chunky pixel art designedfor64x64, fixed orthographic elevated isometric camera. Very squat roof over one rail depot entry, blue steel mouth frame with yellow hoist inside; no giant equipment. Original machinery colors retained. Columns1 NE rearclosed;2 SE frontdoor onlower-right face;3 SW frontdoor onlower-left face;4 NW rearclosed. ForfarNE/NW door hiddenbehind roof andopaque nearwalls, showonlya tinyfartrack stub behindshed ifneeded, no visible near entrance. All poses aligned fixedcamera/lighting.
Rows1 construction shed foundation/incomplete roof/scaffold inside one tile, tiny amber wallbeacon;2 available fullshed/clearopennearentry, green wallbeacon;3 occupied exchange SAMEshed yellowhoist insideentry, amberbeacon;4 blocked SAMEshed redbeacon, short closedbar ONLYatactualentry. No vehicles, wagons, padlocks, text, detachedbackgrounds or shadowsoutsidefloor. Lamp sits on wall not a tall detachedpost. Real alpha transparency.
